breakdown_with_other 02ee014d1549.sql:
WITH g AS (SELECT "country", count(*) AS c, count(DISTINCT "day") AS d, count(DISTINCT "day") FILTER (WHERE "path" = '/p1') AS p FROM views WHERE "project_id" = 1 AND "day" BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-02' AND DATE '2026-09-10' AND "day" >= DATE '2026-09-04' GROUP BY "country"),
		top AS (SELECT * FROM g ORDER BY c DESC, "country" ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 2) SELECT 'Other', count(*) AS c, count(DISTINCT "day") AS d, count(DISTINCT "day") FILTER (WHERE "path" = '/p1') AS p FROM views e WHERE "project_id" = 1 AND "day" BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-02' AND DATE '2026-09-10' AND "day" >= DATE '2026-09-04'
					AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM top WHERE top."country" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM e."country") HAVING count(*) > 0
